providers.name: Mullvad VPN
providers.description: Official GUI and daemon. Paid account; connect after installation.

providers.name: Proton VPN
providers.description: Official GTK client via NetworkManager and shared Secret Service. Free or paid account; NixOS/Hyprland is outside upstream's supported distribution list. Split tunneling is not integrated here.

providers.name: IVPN
providers.description: Official GUI and daemon. Paid account. Pinned GUI is x86 only; service changes reverse-path filtering to loose.

providers.name: Import WireGuard / OpenVPN
providers.description: Import your own profile after installation. No automatic kill switch or provider-specific features.
